name: Shrimp ruốc
summary: Ruốc tôm is sold to take home at chợ Hạ Long 1 and chợ Hạ Long 2. Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, lists it there. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh places ruốc at Quảng Yên. Both stay. This is not a recipe for the Quảng Yên jar.
origin: The two Hạ Long markets, on the 6 May 2020 account, and Quảng Yên on the provincial tourism list. The two attributions are not the same sentence.
howToEat: A gift from the market, on the 2020 account. A method was not printed. The tourism list does not put the Quảng Yên ruốc on a Hạ Long street.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Hạ Long 1 on đường Bạch Đằng and chợ Hạ Long 2 on đường Lê Lợi.
seoTitle: Ruoc tom — sold at the Ha Long markets
seoDescription: Ruốc tôm is a gift at chợ Hạ Long 1 and 2. The provincial tourism list places ruốc at Quảng Yên. Both stay. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
